remarks: Welcome to Malibu Bay Club, one of Malibu's most desirable gated oceanfront communities, offering direct beach access, private coves, and breathtaking coastline views. Completely rebuilt in 2025, this beautifully designed residence features 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a flexible office space, and approximately 1,400 square feet of light-filled living space. Soaring ceilings, skylights, walls of glass, and an open-concept floor plan create the perfect coastal retreat. Enjoy a spacious kitchen, designer finishes, A/C, solar panels, private laundry, and an expansive ocean-view deck overlooking the coastline from County Line Beach to the Channel Islands.
